description: Platform RTP category registry for Canonical Game Schema v1.0.0 MVP

extensionRules.documentOverride: GameVersion may include rtpCategoryRegistry.extends = platform:v1 and add categories; must not redefine platform ids with conflicting decompositionGroup
extensionRules.customCategories: New category ids must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$ and declare decompositionGroup
extensionRules.stateBinding: Every state.rtpCategory must resolve to platform registry OR document registry (GV-025)
extensionRules.winTagging: Runtime tags each win with exactly one primary rtpCategory for decomposition
extensionRules.parentRollup: Optional parent links must be acyclic (GV-030)
extensionRules.deprecation: Removing a platform category requires schema major bump

categories.label: Base Game
categories.description: All wins occurring in base game state (lines, scatters, combined)

categories.label: Free Spins Feature
categories.description: Wins and feature-driven outcomes while Free Spins frame is active

categories.label: Hold and Win Feature
categories.description: Wins from Hold & Win respins including jackpot tier awards

categories.label: Multiplier Adjustments
categories.description: Incremental win adjustments attributable to multiplier plugin when reported separately from base/feature wins

aliases.note: Optional fine-grained split; document registry only
Optional fine-grained split; document registry only

validationRules.rule: state.rtpCategory must be id or alias target in merged registry
No two categories in same decompositionGroup with overlapping exclusive win rules
Published games with FS/H&W states should use FREE_SPINS / HOLD_AND_WIN categories
